documents.name: Morrow_VenueAccess_FICTIONAL.txt
documents.text: FICTIONAL CONTRACT — Morrow Observatory Archive: commercial filming in the reading room requires a venue duty officer to remain present for both planned activities; room access alone says nothing about the lender's permission to handle loaned collections.

inventory.text: FICTIONAL CONTRACT — Morrow Observatory Archive: commercial filming in the reading room requires a venue duty officer to remain present for both planned activities; room access alone says nothing about the lender's permission to handle loaned collections.

documents.name: Atlas_LenderConditions_FICTIONAL.txt
documents.text:
Direct manipulation of the historical atlas must not begin until written lender consent has been presented; during that handling, a supporting book cradle and a padded transfer tray are mandatory, and a collections conservator must remain beside the reading table throughout the take; these conditions concern opening and unfolding the loaned volume, not an interview beside its closed case.

The lender letter describes Variation VA-17 as issued for the close-up in which the performer opens and unfolds the atlas only; it does not extend that variation to the case-only interview; the letter cites Consent Schedule CS-9 as its supporting instrument, but no copy accompanies this letter.

documents.name: Atlas_Correspondence_FICTIONAL.txt
documents.text:
UNSIGNED REQUEST — the producer asks to move the atlas out of the case during the interview and requests that Variation VA-17 be extended to that activity; this request has not been issued as an amendment and awaits the lender's response.

Historical condition record from a previous exhibition: reference photographs show the atlas on a foam wedge with a volunteer demonstrator; that past display record imposes no conditions on this production.
